title: Platform Recommendation and Competition in Search Markets
abstract: arXiv:2611.24464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommendation rules affect both sellers' incentives and the alternatives consumers expect to find. We develop a framework for evaluating these rules with heterogeneous sellers, endogenous pricing and advertising, and costly consumer search. For a broad class of separable recommendation scores, we establish conditions under which a unique market equilibrium exists. Three applications illustrate the use of the framework. A stronger reward for low prices does not necessarily lower equilibrium prices and benefit consumers when products are sufficiently differentiated in qualities. Quality guidance can lower the price of each product and benefit consumers while raising the average transaction price. With heterogeneous match distributions, a reward for the best initial inspection can help consumers with advertising fixed and harm them when advertising adjusts. A two-type design extension shows that no finite optimum over implementable outcome

translated_title: 平台推荐与搜索市场中的竞争
translated_abstract: 推荐规则既影响卖家的激励，也影响消费者预期找到的替代选择。我们开发了一个评估这些规则的框架，其中考虑了异质性卖家、内生定价与广告投放以及消费者的有成本搜索。对于一大类可分离的推荐得分函数，我们建立了唯一市场均衡存在的条件。三个应用展示了该框架的用途：当产品在质量上充分差异化时，对低价格给予更强的奖励并不一定会降低均衡价格并使消费者受益；质量引导可以降低每个产品的价格并使消费者受益，但同时会提高平均交易价格；在匹配分布存在异质性的情况下，对最佳初次考察的奖励在广告固定时可以帮助消费者，而在广告随之调整时则会损害消费者。一个双类型设计的扩展表明，在可实施的结果范围内不存在有限的最优（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个评估平台推荐规则的经济学分析框架，证明对低价的奖励在产品质量充分差异化时未必降低价格惠及消费者，而质量引导虽能降低单品价格却可能抬高平均交易价格。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an economic framework for evaluating platform recommendation rules in search markets, showing that stronger rewards for low prices need not benefit consumers when products differ in quality, and that quality guidance can lower individual prices while raising average transaction prices.
